heading.html: What is a Men’s King Body Scrub?

children.text: The Men’s King Body Scrub is based on the centuries-old Korean exfoliation ritual, designed to detoxify, refresh, and renew your skin. Using a traditional cloth called a sesin, our skilled therapists gently yet effectively remove dead skin cells and impurities, leaving your skin smooth and revitalized. With the extended session time, you’ll enjoy not only a more complete exfoliation but also additional time to relax in our calming spa atmosphere.

heading.html: How the Men’s King Body Scrub Works

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-6cc49da0 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.text: Begin with a 15–20 minute soak in the warm bathhouse tubs. The heat relaxes your muscles and opens pores, priming your skin for exfoliation.
Our therapists use the sesin cloth to thoroughly exfoliate from head to toe. The longer session ensures deeper cleansing and extra attention to areas that need it most.
After exfoliation, you’ll be rinsed with warm water and treated to a nourishing moisturizer, leaving your skin soft, refreshed, and hydrated.

Vanessa Phillips

I can't recommend this place highly enough. My mom and I live fairly far apart but wanted a chill spa weekend together. It was phenomenal to meet up at Dulles, rent a car, and come to king spa! We really enjoyed the scrubs we got (would call a must experience if it's your first time), outdoor pool, and the environment in general. We were lucky enough to come when they have the spring promotion that if you buy entry + a service, another non-weekend entry is free.
Amanda The Traveler

Amazing Korean Spa with everything you may need! My husband and I went here to get away for a little while and I couldn't be happier with my experience! We were there for 6 hours, visited all of there many Sauna's, steam, ice, and relaxing rooms. And you can not forget there hot and warm pools! And when all is said and done you must visit their restaurant for some eggs, cold noodle soup, and shaved ice with red bean (trust me you'll love it!) As Korean spas go it is a pricier option, but we'll worth it given all of the options, if you're in the area you must try!
Deanna

I went to celebrate my birthday weekend and had a relaxing time. The staff was very helpful and give you a key fob for two separate lockers, one for your shoes and the other for your clothes/personal belongings. The nude pool in the locker rooms isn't my thing but it's available to those who are okay with that. The staff is constantly cleaning, which is a plus 👌🏾; keeps the facility nice and clean. The outdoor pools upstairs were nice and warm/hot. They have several different saunas and the food was good 😊. I didn't get to stay as long as I wanted since I had to leave by a certain time to fight the traffic. I would definitely return.
Megan Durst

I've gone with my small group multiple times and with my spouse and we all thoroughly enjoy it. I usually get the body scrub because who doesn't like their skin feeling like a baby's skin? And the ice bath has become one of my favorite parts, but I've always enjoyed the variety of saunas and bade pool, and the outdoor pool(and hot tub, and bridge) is beautiful & can be relaxing too(Just maybe not on a Saturday when it's busy😅). Definitely going back.
Mykyla J

This place was AMAZING, i stepped out of many comfort zones by going here. Things are a little confusing if you are getting the body scrub service, but there were other people there who helped even if the staff couldn't. Everybody was so friendly. I will continue to keep coming back. It's a 4 hour drive from where i stay, but it is worth the drive. I will also bring other people back along with me spreading the word of this amazing place !!!
Asel Dav

heading.html: What to Know Before Your First Korean Body Scrub

children.text: If you’re new to Korean body scrubs, it’s normal to have a few questions. At King Spa, we want you to feel completely at ease. Here are the key things to know before your first appointment:

children.cls: elementor-section elementor-inner-section elementor-element elementor-element-b5bc28 elementor-section-boxed elementor-section-height-default elementor-section-height-default

children.html:
Nudity Is Part of the Experience

Guests are nude during the scrub for more effective exfoliation and scrub treatments are performed in gender-separated areas. This is standard in Korean spa culture and is handled professionally and respectfully by our trained staff.

It Feels Intense—But In a Good Way

The scrub uses a textured glove to remove dead skin. It’s firm and thorough, especially on dry or rough areas. It may feel intense at first, but most guests say it’s deeply satisfying and refreshing.

Don’t Apply Lotions or Shave Beforehand

Avoid using lotions, creams, or oils before your appointment. Also, don’t shave on the day of your scrub—freshly shaved skin can feel more sensitive during the treatment.

Hydrate and Moisturize Afterward

Drink water after your session and apply a gentle, fragrance-free moisturizer. Avoid sun exposure, exfoliating again, or using strong products for a few days so your skin can recover.

children.html:
Is the Korean body scrub suitable for sensitive skin?

No, A Korean body scrub isn’t ideal for all skin types. If your skin is sensitive, you should avoid the treatment unless approved by your therapist.

What makes the Men’s King Body Scrub different from the Classic?

The King Body Scrub is longer than the Classic version, giving you extra time for deeper exfoliation and enhanced relaxation.

Do I need to wear anything during the scrub?

 The treatment is traditionally performed in the nude to allow full exfoliation. Our professional therapists ensure the process is comfortable and respectful.

How often should I get this treatment?

 Many guests enjoy a body scrub once a month for healthy, smooth skin. The King Body Scrub is perfect when you want an even more refreshing reset.

Do you wash hair during a Korean Body Scrub?

Yes, hair washing is included as part of the Korean body scrub treatment.

How do I book the Men’s King Body Scrub?

Appointments are made on-site at King Spa. Simply visit our front desk and our team will help schedule your session.
